'''Joe's''' was an establishment on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]]. A purple neon sign spelled out the name, which was written in [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] symbols.
